acceptance: A stale cache containing an old worktree path is rejected and a current-worktree cache remains reusable; the targeted cache lifecycle tests pass.
brief: iOS test cache can reuse an old worktree path and hide valid test assets.
contract_evidence: Gate 412e61197327dd4f ios-test-unit rc=1; xctestrun embeds old absolute worktree path
detail: The iOS unit Gate reused a cached xctestrun/DerivedData graph whose absolute paths point to integrator-20260819-fan-in-calendar-b2d898f7 instead of the current staging worktree, producing broad fixture and materialization failures. Make cache identity/path validation fail closed and rebuild on worktree drift.
plan: Add current-worktree identity and absolute-path validation to xctestrun cache reuse; invalidate stale cache on drift; add regression coverage for old staging path reuse.
resolution: Classified as medium tooling severity: this is a stale xctestrun/DerivedData cache invalidation problem with no evidence of Calendar product regression; it may be used only as a named non-critical Gate deferral while the recovery lane repairs cache identity.
